pattern_1.transformation: df_meta.csv is row-aligned (positional index) with df_data.csv; the per-row site and calendar date are taken from df_meta.csv. The 'datetime' column is a calendar date only (daily aggregated statistics), localized to midnight UTC. Note: rows were shuffled chronologically by the data provider for ML training; harmonized output is re-sorted by datetime_UTC, site_id, depth_m, replicate.
Direct column mapping (values ph1, ph2, sg5, tb).
No single depth is assignable: swc/swp are depth-weighted averages integrated across four sensor depths (ph1/ph2/sg5: -0.1, -0.3, -0.6, -1.15 m; tb: -0.1, -0.3, -0.5, -0.7 m). depth_m is set to NaN.
Soil water content, depth-weighted average across four TEROS12 sensors. Observed range 0.104-0.395, consistent with m3 m-3; mapped directly.

Soil water potential derived from depth-weighted soil water content via a water-retention relationship (TEROS12/TEROS21 pair at -0.3 m). All values negative (range -8386.02 to -3.45), consistent with kPa; mapped directly.
